tagline: 132 × 104cm and 20cm deep, so a giant breed fits on the bed, not half on the floor.
lead: A giant breed gets the whole bed, with no shoulder on the floor and no head hanging over the edge.
value: A bed this big only works with enough foam depth and enough footprint. Hornbeam has both, plus a waterproof liner so one bad night doesn't end it.
intro: Hornbeam is an XXL orthopaedic dog sofa bed, 132 × 104cm and 20cm deep, with a profiled egg-crate foam core, bolsters on four sides, a lowered front, a flannel sleeping cover and a waterproof liner.
points: 132 × 104cm and 20cm deep, so a giant breed isn't hanging off the edge.
Low enough that a heavy, older dog can step in without hauling themselves up.
Something to lean into on every side.
Spreads the weight of a very heavy dog rather than compressing to the floor.
Protects the foam from accidents and wet coats.
best_for: Giant breeds and very heavy dogs, including older ones who would rather step in than climb.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm, then check your floor space. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Wipe the liner. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
